lane: Backend/AI: Tarot private note (tarot_note) and intent-based reader suggestion (reader_router), batch C remainder, Owner approved 23/11
goal: Add the backend for the free daily private Tarot note and the AI reader suggestion: two new route features (tarot_note, reader_router) with switches, a note claim (1 delivered note a day, failed attempts capped at 3 and not consuming), the note and suggest_reader actions in ai-tarot-reading, decision-API providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini) usable only for reader_router, and Admin visibility. Code only; the migration, deploys and secrets stay Owner actions.
successCriteria: Migration 20261124090000 adds tarot_note and reader_router to route features, publish RPC, step validator and feature switches; decision providers are accepted only for reader_router; tarot_readings gains note, note_created_at and note claim columns; the guard trigger lets only the note columns change and keeps a written note immutable; tarot_note_claim RPC is service-role only and idempotent.

action note (signed-in only) returns {note:{text,need,askThem}, noteStatus, moderationStatus, provenance, model, experiment, nextNoteAt}; a written note is replayed free; 429 daily_limit_reached reason note_daily; 409 note_in_progress; a crisis question returns note null with safety.crisis and never calls a model; a model or format failure returns 503 note_unavailable attemptCounted false and never canned text.
The note output is validated inside the router path (acceptOutput) so a malformed answer tries the fallback model.

action suggest_reader reads question, topic, spread and cards from the stored draw only, accepts candidates only from the active free archetype allowlist, runs decision steps then the chat fallback within 4 seconds, and returns slug null with source none on timeout, error, crisis or quota; quota 20 a user a Vietnam day via usage_events.
No user id, nickname, history, journal or birth data is sent to any decision provider.
resolveFeatureRoute(supabase, feature, userId) returns {route, experiment:null} for both features.
Admin route editor lists the decision providers with a note that they return a choice only and only for reader_router; workflow catalog shows both flows and the data sent.
Deno, backend, Supabase, ledger, Admin and prompt-consumer checks pass.
untouchedSurfaces: Mobile app: the note card, reader suggestion UI and rule tier are another task; request bodies are new actions only.
Model campaigns (tables, Admin page, variant assignment) are built by another agent; experiment is always null here.
The existing interpret, draw, clarify and delete actions, their quotas and stored shapes are unchanged.
PLAN.md is updated by the lead agent, not in this task.
No SQL is applied, no function deployed, no secret set or read.

impact.entryPoint: Tarot result screen: Lời nhắn riêng (note) under the summary, and reader suggestion before choosing a guide; Admin Model router, Feature switches and Workflow pages.
impact.dataWrite: tarot_readings gains note jsonb, note_created_at, note_claim_token, note_claimed_at (service role only, trigger-guarded); usage_events rows tarot_note_attempted, tarot_note_generated, reader_router_attempted, reader_router_result (no question text).
impact.backendContract: ai-tarot-reading actions note and suggest_reader; model_route_versions features tarot_note and reader_router; providers openrouter_decisions, openai_decisions, gemini_decisions for reader_router only. Needs Owner-approved migration and deploys of ai-tarot-reading and admin-model-router-config.
impact.adminVisibility: Route editor lists the new features and decision providers with a no-text note; feature switches for both; workflow catalog shows both flows and data sent; cost-by-feature view already groups by feature (no change).
impact.privacySafety: Note sends the same question and card context as the deep reading. Reader suggestion sends only question, topic, spread, card names and candidate descriptions; no user id, nickname, history, journal or birth data. jev data policy is not verified (not stated on the OpenRouter pages); Gemini free tier data is used to improve products, so gemini_decisions must use a paid key. Crisis questions never reach a model.
impact.observability: Note traces use feature tarot_note with the interpret trace metadata; reader router writes a content-free usage event with source, model and latency.
impact.rollback: Turn the tarot_note or reader_router switch off in Admin; revert the code and redeploy. Migration rollback comment drops the RPC, restores the previous guard and checks; added columns may stay.

canonicalContracts: supabase/functions/_shared/tarot-prompt.ts tarotModelMessage stays the single builder of the Tarot card context; the note reuses it

skillReview.evidence: Record and preflight before edits; PLAN.md left to the lead per brief.

skillReview.name: nilaza-ai-runtime
skillReview.evidence: Sign-in, quota and switch on both actions; output validated in the router path; safety block never falls through; only context the prompt uses is sent; Admin shows the flows; deploys and secrets left to the Owner.

securityReview.authzRls: Both actions require a signed-in, non-anonymous user (shared guard). Note columns are written only by the service role through tarot_note_claim and guarded updates; tarot_note_claim is granted to service_role only. Decision providers are refused for any feature except reader_router in the table check, publish RPC and Admin contract.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Decision providers receive only question, topic, spread, card names and candidate descriptions; no user id (OpenRouter user field not sent), nickname, history, journal or birth data. jev data policy is unverified: recorded here and shown in the Admin note.
securityReview.secretsLogging: OPENAI_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY are read by name only at call time; a missing key is provider_unavailable. No key or question text is logged; usage events carry no question text.
securityReview.externalInput: drawId UUID; candidates must be strings in the server allowlist (max 7); question comes from the stored draw, not the request; decision answers are accepted only when the choice is one of the candidates.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Migration and deploys (ai-tarot-reading, admin-model-router-config) are Owner-approved actions; until then the new actions return feature errors and the default routes are code defaults.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop if a decision provider would need user identifiers or history, if the note would need canned text, or if the guard trigger cannot keep the draw and interpretation immutable.

managerTestPath: After the Owner applies the migration and deploys ai-tarot-reading: draw a love spread, open the result, request the note: a 150-250 word note answers the question and ends with a question to ask the other person; request it again: same note, no new quota; a second draw the same day: daily limit with the next time. Ask for a reader suggestion with a love question: a love-related guide slug or null within 4 seconds.
residualRisk: Decision API request and response shapes are taken from docs only (alpha for OpenRouter) and are not verified with a live call; jev data policy unverified; note quality not verified until a deployed QA run or the blind test.
